_doc: Local -> scorer calibration. Add one point per submitted version once its board time is known: {"version", "local_20m_median_s" (from results/<version>.json), "board_s"}. ratio = median(board_s / local_20m_median_s), set by hand or by `make eval-calibrate`; while null, Gate C uses local times only (a ratio scales both sides equally) and no scorer estimate is printed.
